description: Converts a monostable pulse input into a bi-stable toggle output. Each rising edge on the input toggles the output state. Supports explicit on/off inputs and emits pulse outputs on state transitions.

inputs.name: Toggle
inputs.description: Pulse input signal. On each rising edge (false to true transition), the output will toggle its state.

inputs.name: On
inputs.description: Switches the output (O) on. Only reacts to a rising edge.

inputs.name: Off
inputs.description: Pulse: Resets the output (O) to off. When held on: Block is locked and all other inputs are ignored. Dominant input.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Bi-stable output that toggles its state on each input pulse.

outputs.name: On
outputs.description: Pulse when output (O) is switched on. Fixed 100ms pulse width.

outputs.name: Off
outputs.description: Pulse when output (O) is switched off. Fixed 100ms pulse width.

state.name: Last input state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the toggle input to detect rising edges

state.name: Last on state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the on input to detect rising edges

state.name: Last off state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the off input to detect rising edges and lock state
